zones.title: Verify by PIN
zones.body: The four-digit PIN against the CASE account on the session (in-car) or behind the spoken plate (IVR); test-period stand-in until question 20 is agreed. A match sets verified, stores the customer on the session and account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate and dealer on the case; a miss counts an attempt.

panels.title: AR-18 VerifyIdentity
panels.body: Every caller: the four-digit PIN against the account on the session (in-car) or the account behind the spoken plate (IVR). The PIN is a test-period stand-in until the identification rule is agreed (question 20); the rule lives in the mock and this tool, nowhere else. A match sets verified on the session and writes account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate and dealer to the case. Attempts are counted on the session; the IdentifyExhausted guard in AR-02 hands off after two.
